includedDescription: What's covered with every professional roofing service.
idealDescription: Recommended situations where this service delivers best.
processDescription: From the initial inspection to the final walkthrough, every single step is carefully designed to guarantee outstanding quality without unexpected surprises.

replacement.intro: From roof replacements to targeted repairs, we deliver lasting protection with premium materials, expert craftsmanship, and warranty coverage on every project.
included: Full tear off and deck inspection
Rotted deck replacement (priced separately, never hidden)
New valley metal, ridge vents, and step flashing
Full debris haul off and magnetic nail sweep
Written workmanship guarantee plus manufacturer warranty
ideal: Visible leaks, missing shingles, or sagging areas
Homes preparing for a solar install

inspect.title: Inspect & Estimate
inspect.description: We photograph your full roof condition, then send a written line item quote within twenty four hours.

quote.title: Schedule & Permit
quote.description: We pull the county permit, schedule your crew, and confirm the start date with you in writing.

work.title: Tear Off & Install
work.description: Full tear off with deck check, then new underlayment, valley metal, flashing, shingles or tiles, photographed throughout.

warranty.title: Clean & Walkthrough
warranty.description: Magnetic nail sweep, full debris haul off, a final walkthrough together, and your written guarantee in hand.

shingle.intro: Architectural asphalt shingles from trusted brands deliver classic curb appeal and dependable weather protection, installed by certified crews and backed by strong manufacturer and workmanship warranties.
included: Full inspection of the existing roof
New flashing at every roof penetration
Full cleanup and magnetic nail sweep
ideal: Roofs due for a fresh look

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We document the entire roof condition and share a written report before any new shingle goes down.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get one flat written price valid for thirty days, with no surprise per hour billing later.

work.title: Install And Seal
work.description: Certified crews lay fresh underlayment, shingles, and flashing with tight, straight seams built to shed heavy water.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We inspect the finished roof and hand you both manufacturer and workmanship warranties clearly stated in writing.

metal.intro: Standing seam and ribbed metal systems engineered for decades of service, shrugging off storms, sun and snow while giving your property a clean, modern architectural profile.
included: Full inspection of the existing roof
Standing seam or ribbed metal panels
Full cleanup and magnetic nail sweep
ideal: Areas with heavy sun or storms

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We measure the roof, plan the panel layout, and share a written report before we ever begin.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get one flat written price valid for thirty days, with no surprise per hour billing later.

work.title: Panel And Seam
work.description: Crews set high temperature underlayment first, then lock each metal panel with concealed, weather tight fasteners throughout.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We water test every seam and hand you a long term manufacturer and workmanship warranty in writing.

storm.intro: When storms strike, our emergency crews tarp, secure and repair your roof fast, then document every detail to support your insurance claim from inspection to final approval.
ideal: Roofs hit by wind or hail

inspect.title: Secure And Photo
inspect.description: We tarp the roof fast, then document all the storm damage with detailed photos for your insurer.

quote.title: Claim Support
quote.description: We prepare a detailed scope and work directly with your insurer from initial filing to final approval.

work.title: Repair And Restore
work.description: Once approved, our crews repair or replace the damaged roof with matching, code compliant, storm rated materials.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We inspect the finished work and back every storm repair with our written, long term workmanship warranty.

commercial.intro: From TPO and EPDM membranes to torch applied systems, we install and maintain flat and low slope roofs that keep offices, warehouses and storefronts protected year round.
included: Full inspection of the existing roof
TPO EPDM or torch applied membrane

inspect.title: Survey And Photo
inspect.description: We survey the roof, check drainage, and share a written report with zero disruption to your work.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get a detailed written scope and price with clear terms and absolutely no hidden change orders.

work.title: Membrane Install
work.description: Crews set tapered insulation and membrane with reinforced seams, working quietly around your staff and business hours.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We flood test every seam and then hand you a written manufacturer and workmanship warranty on completion.

maintenance.intro: Seasonal inspections, gutter cleaning and minor tune ups on a set schedule keep small issues from growing, extending your roof's life and protecting your manufacturer warranty.
included: Minor flashing and sealant tune ups

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We check the roof, flashing, and gutters each season, and photograph anything at all needing prompt attention.

quote.title: Simple Plan
quote.description: You get one clear plan and price for the whole year with no surprise per visit billing.

work.title: Clean And Tune
work.description: We clear debris, clean the gutters, and handle minor sealant and flashing fixes on every single visit.

warranty.title: Report And Protect
warranty.description: You receive a written condition report each visit that helps protect and extend your existing roof warranty.

gutters.intro: Seamless gutters and precision flashing keep water moving away from your home, protecting the foundation, siding and roofline from leaks, rot and costly structural damage year after year.
included: Full inspection of gutters and roofline
ideal: Roofs with worn or loose flashing

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We measure the entire roofline, check the flashing, and share a written report before any work begins.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get one flat written price valid for thirty days, with no surprise per hour billing later.

work.title: Form And Fit
work.description: Crews form seamless aluminum gutters right on site, then fit flashing and downspouts for clean, reliable drainage.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We run water through the whole system and back every gutter and flashing job with our warranty.

skylights.intro: We cut, frame, flash and seal new skylights with leak proof precision, bringing natural light into your home while preserving the integrity of your existing roof.
included: Full inspection of the roof deck

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We check the deck and interior, plan the opening, and share a written report before any cutting.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get one flat written price valid for thirty days, with no surprise per hour billing later.

work.title: Cut And Flash
work.description: Crews cut and frame the opening, set the unit and seal it with a leak proof kit.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We water test the finished skylight and back the whole install with our workmanship warranty in writing.

solar.intro: We integrate solar panels with your roofing system the right way, sealed mounts and smart layouts that cut energy bills without ever compromising your roof's protection.
included: Full inspection of the roof structure
Smart panel layout for best output
ideal: Owners going solar the right way

inspect.title: Inspect And Photo
inspect.description: We assess the roof structure and full sun exposure, then share a written report and panel layout.

quote.title: Written Quote
quote.description: You get one flat written price valid for thirty days, with no surprise per hour billing later.

work.title: Mount And Seal
work.description: Crews reinforce the deck as needed, set sealed mounts, and route the wiring cleanly under the panels.

warranty.title: Test And Warranty
warranty.description: We check every seal and connection, and back the roof work with our written workmanship warranty afterward.
